Each step is one recorded action; open a step's picture to see the screen.

## Steps

1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar
   ![Open Studio on the Projects pillar](/media/stories/S2/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png)
2. Press "Start a greenfield project"
   ![Press "Start a greenfield project"](/media/stories/S2/02-press-start-a-greenfield-project.png)
3. Name it, say what it is for, pick the "cli" starter, and press "Create project"
   ![Name it, say what it is for, pick the "cli" starter, and press "Create project"](/media/stories/S2/03-name-it-say-what-it-is-for-pick-the-cli--3-api.png)
4. Check the project is ready for a Flow, and what it still owes
   ![Check the project is ready for a Flow, and what it still owes](/media/stories/S2/04-check-the-project-is-ready-for-a-flow-an-4-api.png)
5. Look at what forge says is still unresolved, and who owes it
   ![Look at what forge says is still unresolved, and who owes it](/media/stories/S2/05-look-at-what-forge-says-is-still-unresol-5-api.png)
6. Review the contract the starter filled in, element by element
   ![Review the contract the starter filled in, element by element](/media/stories/S2/06-review-the-contract-the-starter-filled-i-6-api.png)
7. Read the secrets element — the one a starter cannot guess from a template
   ![Read the secrets element — the one a starter cannot guess from a template](/media/stories/S2/07-read-the-secrets-element-the-one-a-start-7-api.png)
8. Adjust the demo the starter wrote — this CLI needs a third step that runs the built binary — and save the project
   ![Adjust the demo the starter wrote — this CLI needs a third step that runs the built binary — and save the project](/media/stories/S2/08-adjust-the-demo-the-starter-wrote-this-c-8-api.png)
9. Press "Architect →"
   ![Press "Architect →"](/media/stories/S2/09-press-architect-9-api.png)
10. Describe the first piece of work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"
   ![Describe the first piece of work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"](/media/stories/S2/10-describe-the-first-piece-of-work-cap-wha-10-api.png)
11. While it works, check Monitor
   ![While it works, check Monitor](/media/stories/S2/11-while-it-works-check-monitor-11-api.png)
12. Open the session again and answer the Architect's questions about the project
   ![Open the session again and answer the Architect's questions about the project](/media/stories/S2/12-open-the-session-again-and-answer-the-ar-12-api.png)
13. Open the plan and stand at the gate
   ![Open the plan and stand at the gate](/media/stories/S2/13-open-the-plan-and-stand-at-the-gate-13-api.png)
14. Open Studio on the Projects pillar
